patch_description: Replace the biased sorted-coordinate initialization with unbiased uniform sampling in the reference triangle, and optimize a lower-tail objective rather than only the single smallest determinant. The Heilbronn objective is nonsmooth: improving one active triangle often requires temporarily reducing the current minimum while increasing several nearly active constraints. A weighted average of the smallest triangle determinants provides this needed guidance while the recorded incumbent is still selected strictly by the true minimum area. The reduced temperature is scaled to this more informative local objective and avoids excessively random late-stage moves.
